# James O'Sullivan

James O'Sullivan is a software and mechatronics engineering student from Cork, Ireland. He is the co-founder and engineer of Heron Labs and took part in the Patch summer accelerator.

## Notable work

- Heron Labs / Agami: semi-autonomous vessel for river monitoring, collecting GPS-tagged nitrate, conductivity, turbidity and temperature measurements. James led electronics, embedded sensing, ESP32 firmware, LTE/GNSS telemetry, navigation, web monitoring and field testing.
- VEX Robotics: reached a peak ranking of #1 in Europe and attended the VEX World Championship in St. Louis.
- Other work: robotics education, assistive technology, computer vision, embedded systems, full-stack software and mathematical tutoring.
